reactor-four-factor-lifecycle-sim.title: Four-Factor Formula Animated Neutron Life Cycle
reactor-four-factor-lifecycle-sim.desc: Tracks 1000 fast neutrons through their complete generational life cycle: fast fission boost ϵ, resonance escape p during slowing down, thermal utilization f, and reproduction η, computing k∞ = ϵ·p·η·f.

reactor-six-factor-leakage-sim.title: Six-Factor Formula & Finite Core Leakage Balance
reactor-six-factor-leakage-sim.desc: Calculates fast and thermal non-leakage probabilities P_FNL = 1/(1 + Bg²·τ) and P_TNL = 1/(1 + Bg²·L²), demonstrating effective core multiplication keff = k∞ · P_FNL · P_TNL.

reactor-geometric-buckling-geometries-si.title: Geometric Buckling & Flux Profiles in 5 Canonical Geometries
reactor-geometric-buckling-geometries-si.desc: Solves Helmholtz critical wave equation ∇²ϕ + Bg²·ϕ = 0 across sphere, finite cylinder, cube, rectangular parallelepiped, and slab, calculating geometric buckling Bg² and optimum cylinder volume.

reactor-reflected-core-savings-sim.title: Two-Region Reflected Core & Reflector Savings δ
reactor-reflected-core-savings-sim.desc: Solves coupled two-region diffusion equations in multiplying core and non-multiplying reflector, demonstrating the thermal flux peak in the reflector and reduction in critical core size (reflector savings δ).
